liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (2 reviews): The performance is described as viciously powerful, prompting requests for superior soundboard recordings; Garcia's trilling through convincing chord changes is highlighted as a particularly nice guitar technique [13][18]
- **Deal** (1 review): Garcia's solo features four improving verses, described as a masterful storytelling highlight [12]
- **Around and Around** (1 review): The performance is described as awesome, lifting the listener out of a funk [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-02-05.138311.sbd.GEMS.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 149 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1978-02-05.151838.s2.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 11 songs; 86 min [2]
- **gd1978-02-05.151646.mtx.sb34.chappell.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 10 songs; 89 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [6]
- **gd78-02-05.aud.set2.warner.19466.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 10 songs; 85 min; rated 4.61/5 by 28 [7]. Said about its sound: The audio is clean, showing minimal quality drop compared to the official Dick's Picks release; The recording quality is criticized as crummy, despite the performance being a standout of the year [14][17]

## Around the show

- Weir forgot the first verse, struggling to regain control from Garcia's extended solo [12]
- A broken mic caused a bonus jam; Garcia played staccato picks at the roadie [15]
- This thirty-minute version is considered on par with or exceeding shows from 1977 and 1978 [16]
- The Scarlet jam is rated better than any 1977 performance the reviewer has heard [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-02-05.138311.sbd.GEMS.flac16**: transferred by Jamie Waddell and Jason Chastain; source: SBD Master Reel > Cassette > DAT; 16 bit 44.1kHz FLAC Level8 SBE Free; Speed Correction and Patching by Jason Chastain in Audition CC; Mastering by Jamie… [1]. Also: Set one is the first digital circulation, while set two appears on Dick's Picks 18 [1]
- **gd1978-02-05.151838.s2.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Unknown; tape supplied by Doug Lamarre; transferred by SIRMick & Matt Vernon; source: Source: Unknown aud (low gen cassette) - From the collection of Doug Lamarre [2]. Also: Weir's joke was patched from Brian Schley's source, with transfer coordinated by Matt Vernon [2]
- **gd1978-02-05.151646.mtx.sb34.chappell.flac16**: source: Matrixed (edited, mixed and converted) by Chris Chappell [6]. Also: Joe S's board was chosen over a newer GEMS source due to better tonal match with the Warner AUD [6]
- **gd78-02-05.aud.set2.warner.19466.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording [7]

## Art and photos
